verdicts.theirs: the website on file names them
verdicts.unconfirmed: the website on file answers but does not state their full name - usually an acronym, brand or parent; likely theirs, not confirmed
verdicts.found: no website was on file; a guessed domain names them
verdicts.found_review: a guessed domain names them, but a person should confirm it
verdicts.parked: the website on file is a for-sale or holding page
verdicts.unreadable: the website on file did not answer our crawler, nor did its home page - most are bot walls that refuse an identified crawler (by house rule it never poses as a browser), so the site usually exists
verdicts.not_found: no website on file, and no guessed domain named them or let our crawler read it - NOT a finding that they have no website
verdicts.duplicate: the same company as another record (see duplicate_of)
verdicts.related: on the same website as another record and named like it - the same company or a division of it; a person decides, never merged
verdicts.not_a_company: the name is not a company: an address, a number or site navigation
verdicts.listing_menu: a page off an association's own site, most likely a menu item
verdicts.listing_site: the website on file is the association page that listed them, and no site of their own was found
